title: When the Portrait Breaks
author: Bram Quintana
blurb: Silas Yarrow, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
